description: This Java source file defines the ContextFilter class, which implements the javax.servlet.Filter interface. It configures and manages context-related objects for OFBiz web applications, including initialization, request filtering, multitenant support, and cleanup.

classes.name: ContextFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter for configuring context objects, handling multitenancy, and managing application setup and cleanup in OFBiz web applications.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter, sets up context parameters, security, delegator, dispatcher, and checks for multitenant configuration.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Processes each request, sets request attributes, manages multitenant delegator switching, and continues the filter chain.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, deregisters dispatcher, and nullifies configuration.

methods.name: putAllInitParametersInAttributes
methods.description: Copies all servlet context init parameters into context attributes for easier access.

methods.name: getServerId
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the server ID from context attributes or init parameters.
